title: Ministry of Culture raids a press conference

tellings.quote: Just look at what the Peruvian Ministry of Culture did to Joyce Mantilla during one of the press conferences around the bodies.

plain: Peru's Ministry of Culture is said to have raided a press conference about mummified three-fingered bodies found in Peru, going after a woman named Joyce Mantilla who was involved in presenting them. Michels tells this himself, without giving details, pointing to it as an example of how hard Peruvian officials pushed back against the people promoting the bodies.
